note: *como os mortos de outrora* (DRB's sense). Two Latinist runs, two fixes: *do século* (heard as 'of the century') and MS1932's *de há muito* (European ear). The blind reader did not know *outrora* but heard it rightly.

*e serei semelhante*, the Latin's plain *et*; the blind reader said most will infer 'otherwise' but the *e* invites the wrong reading. *senão serei* names it; MS1932's *para que eu não seja* changes the grammar.
*em vós me refugiei*, the Thursday Lauds antiphon; the gate Latinist asks *a vós me acolhi* for the motion of *ad te* (*acolher* is suscípere's). MS1932's *junto de vós* keeps the direction.
*O vosso espírito bom*, lower case as the DO Latin and 50:13 (D44); the capital *Espírito* would name the Person, as the Church reads the line.
